from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import math
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

from triangulate_3d import get_ray, intersect_rays

# Poses from history:
# obs1: (0, 0, 0)
# obs2: (0, 0, 90)
# obs4: (0, 0, 270)
# obs10: (0.5, 1.5, 90)
# obs15: (0, 1.5, 0)
# obs16: (0.5, 1.5, 90)
# obs18: (0, 2.0, 270)
# obs19: (-0.5, 2.0, 270)
# obs20: (-0.5, 2.0, 0)

objects = {}

# 1. Floor Lamp:
# Base center in obs2, obs10, obs16
# Let's find the bottom center pixel of the lamp base in obs2 and obs16
im2 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0002.png'))
im16 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0016.png'))

m2 = (im2[:,:,0] > 60) & (im2[:,:,0] < 90) & (im2[:,:,1] > 65) & (im2[:,:,1] < 95) & (im2[:,:,2] > 75) & (im2[:,:,2] < 105) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 380)
c2 = np.argwhere(m2)
u2 = (c2[:,1].min() + c2[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v2 = c2[:,0].max() # base bottom

m16 = (im16[:,:,0] > 60) & (im16[:,:,0] < 90) & (im16[:,:,1] > 65) & (im16[:,:,1] < 95) & (im16[:,:,2] > 75) & (im16[:,:,2] < 105) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 380)
c16 = np.argwhere(m16)
u16 = (c16[:,1].min() + c16[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v16 = c16[:,0].max()

pt_lamp = intersect_rays([get_ray(u2, v2, 0, 0, 90), get_ray(u16, v16, 0.5, 1.5, 90)])
print("Floor lamp:", pt_lamp)

# 2. Potted plant:
# Center of pot base in obs1 and obs16
im1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png'))
m_pot1 = (im1[:,:,0] > 100) & (im1[:,:,0] < 170) & (im1[:,:,1] > 40) & (im1[:,:,1] < 80) & (im1[:,:,2] < 40) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 400)
c_pot1 = np.argwhere(m_pot1)
u_pot1 = (c_pot1[:,1].min() + c_pot1[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v_pot1 = c_pot1[:,0].max()

m_pot16 = (im16[:,:,0] > 70) & (im16[:,:,0] < 130) & (im16[:,:,1] > 30) & (im16[:,:,1] < 70) & (im16[:,:,2] < 40) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 50)
c_pot16 = np.argwhere(m_pot16)
u_pot16 = (c_pot16[:,1].min() + c_pot16[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v_pot16 = c_pot16[:,0].max()

pt_plant = intersect_rays([get_ray(u_pot1, v_pot1, 0, 0, 0), get_ray(u_pot16, v_pot16, 0.5, 1.5, 90)])
print("Potted plant:", pt_plant)

# 3. Chair:
# obs4 (0,0,270), obs18 (0,2,270), obs19 (-0.5,2,270)
im4 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0004.png'))
im18 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0018.png'))
im19 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0019.png'))

m_ch4 = (im4[:,:,0] > 100) & (im4[:,:,0] < 160) & (im4[:,:,1] > 50) & (im4[:,:,1] < 85) & (im4[:,:,2] < 40)
c_ch4 = np.argwhere(m_ch4)
u_ch4 = (c_ch4[:,1].min() + c_ch4[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v_ch4 = c_ch4[:,0].max()

m_ch18 = (im18[:,:,0] > 100) & (im18[:,:,0] < 160) & (im18[:,:,1] > 50) & (im18[:,:,1] < 85) & (im18[:,:,2] < 40)

u_ch18 = (c_ch18[:,1].min() + c_ch18[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v_ch18 = c_ch18[:,0].max()

m_ch19 = (im19[:,:,0] > 100) & (im19[:,:,0] < 160) & (im19[:,:,1] > 50) & (im19[:,:,1] < 85) & (im19[:,:,2] < 40)
c_ch19 = np.argwhere(m_ch19)
u_ch19 = (c_ch19[:,1].min() + c_ch19[:,1].max()) / 2.0
v_ch19 = c_ch19[:,0].max()

print("Chair:", pt_chair)

im20 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0020.png'))

def get_blue_vase(im):
    m = (im[:,:,2] > 150) & (im[:,:,0] < 50) & (im[:,:,1] < 100)
    c = np.argwhere(m)
    return (c[:,1].min() + c[:,1].max()) / 2.0, c[:,0].max()

u_v1, v_v1 = get_blue_vase(im1)
u_v15, v_v15 = get_blue_vase(im15)
u_v20, v_v20 = get_blue_vase(im20)

    # restrict to u in [180, 280]
    m &= (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 280)
    c = np.argwhere(m)
    return (c[:,1].min() + c[:,1].max()) / 2.0, (c[:,0].min() + c[:,0].max()) / 2.0

u_st1, v_st1 = get_stool_top(im1)
u_st15, v_st15 = get_stool_top(im15)
u_st20, v_st20 = get_stool_top(im20)
pt_stool_top = intersect_rays([get_ray(u_st1, v_st1, 0, 0, 0), get_ray(u_st15, v_st15, 0, 1.5, 0), get_ray(u_st20, v_st20, -0.5, 2.0, 0)])
print("Stool top center (x, y, z):", pt_stool_top)

# 6. Table:
# Table top center or legs
def get_table_top(im):
    m = (im[:,:,0] > 100) & (im[:,:,0] < 160) & (im[:,:,1] > 40) & (im[:,:,1] < 80) & (im[:,:,2] < 35)
    m &= (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 350)
    c = np.argwhere(m)
    return (c[:,1].min() + c[:,1].max()) / 2.0, (c[:,0].min() + c[:,0].max()) / 2.0

u_tb1, v_tb1 = get_table_top(im1)
u_tb15, v_tb15 = get_table_top(im15)
u_tb20, v_tb20 = get_table_top(im20)
pt_table = intersect_rays([get_ray(u_tb1, v_tb1, 0, 0, 0), get_ray(u_tb15, v_tb15, 0, 1.5, 0), get_ray(u_tb20, v_tb20, -0.5, 2.0, 0)])
print("Table center (x, y, z):", pt_table)

# 7. Cabinet:
def get_cab_top(im):
    # white top
    m = (im[:,:,0] > 200) & (im[:,:,1] > 200) & (im[:,:,2] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 290)
    # in obs1: u in [280, 360], in obs20: u in [380, 512]
    c = np.argwhere(m)
    return (c[:,1].min() + c[:,1].max()) / 2.0, (c[:,0].min() + c[:,0].max()) / 2.0

u_cb1, v_cb1 = get_cab_top(im1)
u_cb20, v_cb20 = get_cab_top(im20)
pt_cab = intersect_rays([get_ray(u_cb1, v_cb1, 0, 0, 0), get_ray(u_cb20, v_cb20, -0.5, 2.0, 0)])
print("Cabinet center (x, y, z):", pt_cab)

# 8. Sofa:
# In obs1 (u in [0, 131], v in [275, 385])
# In obs19 (cam: -0.5, 2.0, yaw=270): u in [336, 511], v in [303, 469]
u_sf1 = 65.0
v_sf1 = 330.0 # center of sofa in obs1
u_sf19 = 423.0
v_sf19 = 386.0 # center of sofa in obs19
pt_sofa = intersect_rays([get_ray(u_sf1, v_sf1, 0, 0, 0), get_ray(u_sf19, v_sf19, -0.5, 2.0, 270)])
print("Sofa center (x, y, z):", pt_sofa)
